reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but repeats the skip-versus-shift policy instead of sharing the complete occurrence decision.

duplication.why: The daily/non-daily and weekend-enabled dispatch appears in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, and getDatesInRange.

placement.why: Handler registration and shared holiday matching follow existing layers, but scheduling policy is split between shared utilities and server handlers.

scope.why: All edits directly support the requested scheduling rules, range handler, configuration field, or associated tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate three policy implementations and separate occurrence-search bounds whenever exclusion rules evolve.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts independently implement the occurrence policy also implemented by shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: The same enabled/daily/excluded-day/shift decision is expressed as nested branches in getUpcomingDates, a guard plus ternary in getDatesInRange, and iteration plus guards in getNextDate.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; getNextDate gains a daily filtering branch, a daily fallback rejection branch, and a non-daily restriction on adjustment; both server date handlers independently implement that policy.
